titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, BBC News
mainText: Five people were shot dead at a youth welfare centre in northern Germany.
A earthquake in Venezuela resulted in 1,719 deaths and more than 5,000 injuries.

titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: Two boys were rescued from rubble in Venezuela following an earthquake after being trapped for multiple days.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, CBC News
mainText: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of Ukraine stated that Russian strikes killed 11 people and wounded at least 40 in Ukraine.
The U.S. Supreme Court blocked President Trump's attempt to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook.
